description: Sends a confirmation email to the client with the exact proposed online consultation details, booking rules and privacy notice. The client must open the link, review the details and personally confirm consent. This tool does not reserve a slot or initiate payment. Collect no clinical history.

consultationLanguage.description: Consultation language: pl for Polish or ru for Russian.

date.description: Exact proposed appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

email.description: Client’s email address. The consent confirmation link and booking correspondence are sent to this address.

interfaceLanguage.description: Optional language for the consent email and confirmation interface: pl for Polish or ru for Russian. Defaults to the consultation language.

name.description: Client’s full name, as the client wants it recorded for this consultation.

phone.description: Optional client phone number, including country code if supplied. Omit it if it is not needed.

time.description: Exact proposed appointment start time in 24-hour HH:MM format, using the Europe/Warsaw time zone.

name: request_client_consent
title: Send the client a consent confirmation link
